Human: Q: In 1714, when John and Charles went to school in London, John's age was 4 times Charles'. The sum of their ages when John became the Master of St John's College, Cambridge, was 50 years old. Find the age of Charles at the time.
A: When John was the Master, the sum of their ages was 50, so the age of Charles was 50 - 40 = 10. In 1714, when John and Charles went to school in London, their ages were 10 and 1 / 4 * 10 = 2. The age difference between them was 10 - 2 = 8 years. The age of Charles was 2, so the age of John was 8 + 2 = 10.
The answer is 2.
